part.text: The failing test is `TestMiddlewareCalledOnceByRouterStaticFSNotFound` (routes_test.go:455). The problem is in `createStaticHandler` (routergroup.go:242): on file-not-found it re-runs the whole `allNoRoute` chain, which re-executes global middleware (hence the duplicate log lines). Let me check how upstream gin fixed this:

part.text: Fixed. In `createStaticHandler` (routergroup.go:242), the file-not-found path switched the context to `engine.allNoRoute`, re-running all global middleware (e.g., Logger → duplicate log lines). Changed it to `engine.noRoute`, matching the upstream fix — user's NoRoute handlers still run, but middleware executes only once per request. All tests pass (`go test ./...`), including the reproduction test `TestMiddlewareCalledOnceByRouterStaticFSNotFound`.
